svg.aria-label: Harambee Compute architecture. A student asks the teacher laptop. The teacher laptop and two helper laptops share one phone hotspot with the internet off. Helpers find the coordinator with Hyperswarm, model layers and tokens travel through encrypted HyperDHT pipes, every answer's work is written to a Hypercore ledger, and helpers are paid in sats with a WDK Spark wallet when the internet is back.

g.text: one hotspot · one model · everyone who helps gets paid

svg.text: Phone hotspot or router · internet OFF

g.text: encrypted HyperDHT pipe · layers and tokens
leaves the hotspot only to pay
Helpers find the teacher laptop with the code.
The teacher approves; real free memory is read.
Each laptop gets layers for its free memory.
Every token passes through every laptop's layers.
Each helper's work is signed into the ledger.
Helpers get sats once the internet is back.
